summary: VaultPop Build 11 second-pass verified end-to-end on preview. Backend 12/12 pytest cases PASS on preview base https://vaultpop-premium.preview.emergentagent.com/api: POST /v1/auth/password-reset returns 200 {accepted:true, message:'If an account exists for this email, a reset request has been received. Support will follow up.'} for the known qa.player@vaultpop.app AND for a random unknown email — bodies are byte-identical (no account-existence leak); invalid email 'not-an-email' returns 400 {error}; missing email field returns 400 {error}. POST /v1/ads/events returns 202 {recorded:true} for {installId:'test-agent-install', event:'granted', rewardType:'vault_coins'} (also verified for granted+bonus_life and failed+vault_coins); returns 400 {error:'Invalid ad event.'} for event:'bogus', bogus rewardType, and short installId. Regression: POST /v1/auth/login for qa.player@vaultpop.app / VaultPopQA2026!x (installId 'qa-install-1') returns 200 with token + state.account.email; GET /v1/account with Bearer returns 200 with state.balance. Frontend on 390x844 verified: /account shows 'Forgot password?' pressable under Sign In (testID account-forgot-password), tapping it with qa.player email prefilled produces the status pill 'If an account exists for this email, a reset request has been received. Support will follow up.'; sign-in with qa.player / VaultPopQA2026!x succeeds (account-refresh-button visible), tapping Account Sync shows 'Account synced.' pill; /shop hero shows 'Currently Unavailable' button and the exact copy 'VaultPass is unavailable right now. Products load from the App Store on your device.' (testID shop-vaultpass-unavailable); tapping the Bonus Life rewarded WATCH AD (testID shop-rewarded-button) renders the shop-reward-status text ending in 'Ad unavailable right now. Try again later.' — no silent failure. Zero console errors during the run.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings carried from earlier iterations remain. Not introduced by Build 11 patch. References: /app/frontend/src/screens/shop-screen.tsx (pointerEvents inline in gradient styles, lines ~630, 720), /app/frontend/src/screens/round-result-screen.tsx, /app/frontend/src/screens/gameplay-screen.tsx (textShadow* props).

action_items: None required for Build 11 patch. Optional cleanup carried from prior iterations: consolidate textShadow* into `textShadow` shorthand and gate useNativeDriver behind Platform.OS !== 'web' in home-screen.tsx / round-result-screen.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /v1/auth/password-reset correctly avoids existence leak — same JSON body returned for known/unknown, no timing branch that would tip existence; DB write only happens when account exists AND no pending reset (idempotent).
server.py /v1/ads/events validates installId length (4..200) + strict event enum {granted, failed} + rewardType enum {bonus_life, vault_coins} — matches contract exactly.

shop-screen.tsx watchRewarded() fires reportRewardedAdEvent on every failed/ineligible branch (fire-and-forget) and on granted — good coverage; when eligibility fails immediately, the 'Loading ad...' pending message transitions cleanly to the 'Ad unavailable right now. Try again later.' error state (observed in browser).

account-screen.tsx forgotPassword() prompts to enter email first if empty (good UX), sets busy state, and surfaces server message via requestPasswordReset. testID='account-forgot-password' is present with min 44pt touch target (minHeight:44).
server.py still uses datetime.utcnow() in several places (deprecated in Py3.12+) mixed with datetime.now(timezone.utc); harmless today but should be normalized to timezone-aware in a future pass.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 new patch tests; existing 31 auth/support + 12 leaderboard suites remain green from prior iterations)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 requested flows verified: forgot-password link visibility+tap, reset status copy, sign-in, Account Sync toast, shop-vaultpass-unavailable copy + button label, rewarded ad error feedback)

seed_data_creation: No new accounts created (qa.player@vaultpop.app already seeded and reused). Ad-event test rows inserted into vaultpop_ad_events (installId='test-agent-install', 3 rows). One password-reset row may have been upserted for qa.player@vaultpop.app (idempotent, status='pending'). All harmless for regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://vaultpop-premium.preview.emergentagent.com. Run regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` covers auth+support+leaderboard+build11 patch (43+ tests total). Endpoint contracts confirmed: /v1/auth/password-reset returns identical body {accepted:true, message:'If an account exists ...'} regardless of email existence, 400 on invalid email/missing field. /v1/ads/events returns 202 {recorded:true} on valid granted|failed + bonus_life|vault_coins, 400 {error:'Invalid ad event.'} otherwise. Frontend testIDs added in this patch: account-forgot-password, shop-vaultpass-unavailable, shop-reward-status. qa.player@vaultpop.app / VaultPopQA2026!x remains valid. Web preview will always show 'Ad unavailable right now. Try again later.' because ads/StoreKit are unimplemented on web — this is the intentional graceful failure path.
